summary: Reporters get a fact sheet on {issue} while staff prepare to take detailed questions.
realLife: Carter announced a public fact sheet and a longer press briefing on the administration's response to the Kemeny report.
gates: The executive's office is preparing a public statement on an incident.
weights: More verified details than the speaker can give in person favor a written supplement.
inGame: needs: publication and revision of a briefing sheet.

turns.what: The press office circulates the figures before the president speaks.
turns.pulledBy: The figures are verified and reporters have requested them.
turns.writesBack: The first published account links to the advance sheet.

turns.what: The office releases a sheet with one answer marked pending.
turns.pulledBy: Two agencies have returned different totals.
turns.writesBack: A later correction identifies the figure and its source.
